name: Buy Me a Coffee Alerts
description: A Buy Me a Coffee supporter lands on your stream as an alert: who and how much, written the way you write money, with a sound, a spoken line and a message in chat. It shows inside every overlay you have in OBS. Installs the alert and connects Buy Me a Coffee: paste the link this gives you into a webhook there, paste back the secret it shows, then send yourself a test event and watch it land.
changelog: First release: Buy Me a Coffee alerts as a product of their own.
ready_message: The alert is wired and waiting. Send yourself a test event from Buy Me a Coffee and watch it land in your overlay.
notes: A test event from the Buy Me a Coffee dashboard travels the whole way, so it proves more than anything Overlabels could fake. Press it once; pressing it again needs test mode on for Buy Me a Coffee.
The alert shows inside every static overlay of yours, on top of whatever is there. Its Targeting tab can narrow that down to particular overlays, but nothing needs it.
Buy Me a Coffee sends more than one-off support: memberships, extras, commissions and wishlist purchases too. The alert's Triggers tab switches those on for the same alert.
Once Buy Me a Coffee is connected, its counter and latest supporter are controls of yours for any overlay you write: [[[c:bmac:donations_received]]] and [[[c:bmac:latest_donor_name]]].
